newsitem.title: USA: Lexmark files for 10 mln shr secondary.
newsitem.headline: Lexmark files for 10 mln shr secondary.

text.p: Lexmark International Group Inc said on Wednesday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed secondary public offering of 10 million shares of its Class A common stock.
The company said that selling stockholders would be offering only a portion of their holdings in the company, and current members of management have chosen not to sell any shares in the offering.
The selling shareholders are also offering a 1.5 million share over-allotment option, Lexmark said, pointing out the company would not receive any proceeds of the offering.
Goldman, Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co. Inc, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Smith Barney Inc will act as co-managers for the proposed U.S. offering.

Lexmark, a former division of International Business Machines Corp, was acquired in 1991 by a group of investors led by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice Inc, a New York investment firm. Lemark, develops, manufactures and supplies printing solutions and products.
